title: Venezuela Defense of Human Rights and Civil Society Extension Act of 2016
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the Senate on April 28, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Venezuela Defense of Human Rights and Civil Society Extension Act of 2016

(Sec. 2) This bill amends the Venezuela Defense of Human Rights and Civil Society Act of 2014 to extend through December 31, 2019, provisions requiring the President to impose sanctions against individuals in Venezuela who are responsible for human rights violations.

summary.headline: This law extends, through December 31, 2019, the requirement that the President sanction individuals in Venezuela who are responsible for human rights violations.
summary.what_it_does: The law amends the Venezuela Defense of Human Rights and Civil Society Act of 2014. It keeps in place the rules that require the President to impose sanctions on people in Venezuela who are responsible for human rights violations. The extension runs through December 31, 2019. The official summary does not list the specific sanctions or the names of targeted people.

who_it_affects.group: Individuals in Venezuela found responsible for human rights violations
who_it_affects.how: They remain subject to required U.S. sanctions until the extended authority expires on December 31, 2019.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted July 15, 2016; the extended sanctions requirement runs through December 31, 2019.
